caption: The drawing depicts a single glass compote dish centered on a plain background. The compote has a wide, shallow bowl with a smooth rounded edge, supported by a short stem and a broad, circular base. The dish is rendered in shades of light blue and turquoise, with white highlights and subtle grey shading that suggest reflections and transparency, giving it a glass-like appearance. The drawing is framed by two blue rectangular outlines: one larger rectangle surrounding the entire composition and a smaller one where the base intersects with the bottom boundary, as well as a horizontal blue line intersecting the stem at about the lower third of the image. The background remains a light beige color, providing contrast to the blue and turquoise hues of the compote dish.
title: Compote
